text:
Marisa: Sim runs show lost-in-flight writes when lease flips mid-request. Proposal: proxy escrow + delegate-forward: proxy durably stores a short-lived escrow and replays to the authoritative owner instead of synchronous lease swap.

alex: Helps safety. Costs: tail latency + tiny storage. Need idempotency keys and seq metadata.

devon: Residency constraints critical. Escrow must carry residency_policy and never forward outside allowed regions; otherwise quarantine and page ops.

sam: Durability: replicate escrow in-region to one standby (replication=2) and ship lightweight metadata to control plane. TTL short (default 180s).

nina: Observability: escrow_inflight, forward_p95, quarantined_count, replay_attempts. Expose write_token for status and read-through.

marisa: Client contract: default 202 + write_token. Background forwarder applies. sync=true opt-in for strong commit. Handshake: POST /handoff with signed token; target verifies owner; reply 409 + owner_hint on mismatch. Retries then escalate.

ops-bot: [automation] defaults: escrow_replication=2; ttl_secs=180; forward_retry_limit=5; quarantine_retention_days=14.

marisa: Next steps: short RFC patch with token spec, escrow payload, metrics, and staged rollout (dark-launch -> non-sovereign canary -> sovereign after legal). I'll draft runbook and prototype in staging.
